primitives.name: Beginner Protection Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Protect beginners.** The basic question is always welcome; mocking a beginner is a removable offense.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'B_{\\text{beginner}}': 'dimensionless binary indicator (1 if protected, 0 otherwise)', 'Q_{\\text{basic}}': 'dimensionless query intensity'}
primitives.assumptions: Query intensity Q_basic is bounded above by a fixed threshold; mocking behavior is modeled as a negative feedback term in a social utility function.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When Q_basic exceeds threshold, B_beginner drops to 0 due to removal policy.

layer2.mapping: GSI's Bayesian update on query type and intent; GSE's state transition to moderation queue when Q_basic > threshold.
layer2.telemetry: Moderation log frequency of beginner-mocking removals.

primitives.name: Decision Quality Guardian
primitives.verbatim_quote: We protect decision quality.** No pressure to bet, no shame for sitting out, no chasing-losses dynamics, ever.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'D_{\\text{quality}}': 'dimensionless decision quality score', 'P_{\\text{bet}}': 'probability of betting action', 'C_{\\text{chase}}': 'dimensionless chase-losses signal'}
primitives.assumptions: D_quality is a monotonic function of P_bet and C_chase; no external pressure forces P_bet above baseline.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When C_chase > 0, D_quality decays below threshold.

layer2.mapping: GSI's risk-adjusted decision model; GSE's state transition to 'no-pressure' mode when C_chase > 0.
layer2.telemetry: Frequency of 'no-chase' state transitions in room logs.

primitives.name: Certainty Avoidance Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: **No manufactured certainty.** Community "locks"/"free money"/"guaranteed" talk gets the same treatment as our own copy: it does not stand.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C_{\\text{cert}}': 'dimensionless certainty signal strength', 'T_{\\text{talk}}': 'time-series of certainty-related utterances'}
primitives.assumptions: C_cert is a time-weighted average of T_talk; any C_cert > threshold triggers policy enforcement.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When C_cert exceeds threshold, T_talk is flagged for moderation.

layer2.mapping: GSI's certainty signal detection; GSE's state transition to 'policy-alert' when certainty exceeds bounds.
layer2.telemetry: Rate of certainty-flagged utterances in chat logs.
